title: Dynamic SQL executed from text (tsql) — review required
description: A tsql routine executes a statement built as text. If any part of that text is untrusted input, the statement structure is attacker-controlled. This lexical rule flags the execution; the reviewer confirms the text is constant or parameterized.
remediation: Use sp_executesql with typed parameters, and keep input out of the statement text.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: any dynamic execution form matches, including constant statements.
